# Urvar Natural

> Urvar Natural Pvt. Ltd. is a science-driven organic fertilizer and bio-stimulant manufacturer based in West Bengal, India. Products restore soil health and boost crop productivity through organic manures, phosphate fertilizers, bio-stimulants, and micronutrients.

## Products

- [All products](https://urvarindia.com/products/): Full catalog across all categories
- [Organic Manures](https://urvarindia.com/products/category/organic-manures/)

- [Bio-Stimulants](https://urvarindia.com/products/category/bio-stimulants/)
- [Micronutrients](https://urvarindia.com/products/category/micronutrients/)
